sources.scope: Ontario assertions only; all explicitly listed accepted species/subspecies/varieties retained separately
sources.rule: Ontario occurrenceStatus='present' AND establishmentMeans='native', accepted identity. No parent-species propagation.
sources.notes: Counts are taxon records, not unique species. Taxa without an Ontario assertion are outside this subset scope. Synonyms remain in the original archive.

sources.scope: Only the 11 Kew identities researched for the original 100 plants, not the complete Kew flora
sources.rule: Keep explicit Ontario-native evidence; retain original plant 89 for identity review.
sources.notes: Ontario evidence for 440925-1: https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:440925-1 . Other ranges and citations are retained in original distribution_note fields. Global intended-identity review is not cleared.

sources.rule: Keep L1-L5. Review LX, L+?, LU and LU+. Exclude L+.
Keep native_status_as_published='native'; review unknown and mixed statuses.
sources.notes: Source classification is retained as published. It is not a species range polygon or a guarantee of indigenous origin at every site.

sources.scope: Separate Halton and Hamilton inventory-area evidence; never assign both if one has no positive status
sources.rule: Conservative native-list-context filter: positive C/U/R; no I/H?/green nurse-crop flag; unique exact VASCAN Ontario-native corroboration. Rare records retained as native, not approved for planting.
sources.notes: C/U/R are abundance codes, not an explicit native boolean. This subset is a documented inference using the native-list context plus provincial corroboration; independent local indigenous status may still require inventory review. VASCAN infraspecific-to-species propagation is not used.

sources.scope: Toronto compilation study area, subject to verified study extent
sources.rule: Keep EXOTIC_NATIVE=N; review unknown, SX/SH and cultivation flags; exclude E. Conservation rarity/uncertainty does not by itself negate a clear N status.
sources.notes: Latin-1 byte-preserving fallback (source has mixed/garbled author encoding). Original source bytes remain in the ZIP; author-text encoding issues are flagged, not guessed or used to change native status.

policy: Ontario-native for VASCAN/Kew; local source status for regional lists; uncertainty separated; sources preserved.
